_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); extra fields are ignored by skill-creator's runner. Rules: the evergreen plugin's protocol/TESTING.md.

evals.prompt: make a line graph with time as x and price as y from prices.csv
can you add some relevant graphs to this report? it's the quarterly-summary.md in this folder
what kind of chart should I use to show how people drop off between the steps of our signup funnel?
add the horizon chart to the chart knowledge base with a note that it is niche
expectations: the chartwright skill is not invoked (chartwright-curate's job)

evals.prompt: draw a sequence diagram of the login flow between the browser, the API and the auth service
expectations: the chartwright skill is not invoked (a diagram with no data)

evals.prompt: build a bar chart of sales by region from tests/fixtures/sales.csv for the README (markdown)
expectations: cw.py pick or cw.py build was run (trace), and a mermaid block or image was produced, proven by the trace or a written file, not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: filled by the first run: a fresh session without the skill typically writes a mermaid block by hand from the CSV without profiling or the chooser

evals.prompt: render a PNG line chart of price over time from tests/fixtures/prices.csv into out/price.png
expectations: out/price.png exists and is larger than 1000 bytes
the reply names the chart type and the rule that picked it in one to three lines
